$comment: Built on SIP — Proving Ground lane registry. Maps each lane to the existing eval infra it composes. The Proving Ground does not duplicate measurement; it unifies it.

lanes.title: Model
lanes.measures: Capability + instruction compliance + behavioral safety of models run in-harness; + Visual Eval dimension (prompt adherence, legibility, composition quality for Queen LEDGER artifacts: arena cards, routing heatmaps, mempalace slices)
lanes.verification: self-verifying asserts + ground-truth + blind non-contestant judge; model receipts MUST include or reference a visual artifact (image_gen path or prompt+result ref) or explicit 'visualComposerTest' / 'visualEval' field per v0.2 Queen doctrine
lanes.status: live (R1 baseline + R2 stress shipped 2026-06-09); Visual Eval required on all model-lane receipts from 2026-06-12 onward (see 2026-06-12-grok-composer25-model-lane.json exemplar)

lanes.title: Memory
lanes.measures: recall@k, precision@10, latency p50/p95 of the memory substrate
lanes.verification: replay-only recall against real voice-session corpus; no synthetic benchmarks
lanes.status: harness live; Phase-0 dog-food in progress; precision@10 baseline = 0.20

lanes.title: Retrieval
lanes.measures: BM25/FTS5 ranking quality on the public golden corpus
lanes.verification: labeled query set against shipped public-vault corpus
lanes.status: live; baseline 100% recall@5 on 10 labeled queries

lanes.title: Harness
lanes.measures: Trust-contract + envelope + privacy + provenance integrity (7 risk dimensions)
lanes.verification: isolated temp-server assertions per risk dimension

lanes.title: Substrate
lanes.measures: Symmetry invariants — CLAUDE.md<->AGENTS.md, skill-rules<->skills, vertical coverage
lanes.verification: structural symmetry assertions with EXEMPT ledgers

lanes.title: Datasets
lanes.measures: Provenance + labeling honesty of every eval set (no synthetic-benchmark smuggling)
lanes.receipts: this lane is an audit, not a metric — verdict only
lanes.verification: manual + scripted: every dataset names its source and labeling method

lanes.title: System
lanes.measures: Unifying scorecard + Luminor-kernel Overseer synthesis across lanes 1-6
lanes.verification: composition of lane verdicts + named system-level weakness

lanes.title: Deep Reasoning (R5)
lanes.measures: Whether the expensive model tiers buy fewer WRONG ANSWERS than the cheap tiers on problems where one bad intermediate step propagates — cost-adjusted, four Claude tiers, six ground-truth tasks
lanes.receipts: tools/arena/runs/2026-08-28-r5-deep-reasoning.json; run-local receipts land in tools/arena/out/ and a reviewed run is promoted to runs/ by hand
lanes.verification: fully mechanical — each task declares ground truth and accepting regexes matched against the reply's final ANSWER line; twelve pre-registered attractors distinguish a near-miss from noise. No LLM judge: all four Claude tiers are contestants, so no Claude model is a non-contestant judge (R5-DESIGN.md section 6). Binary scoring, no partial credit. Credential-graceful: with no usable model credential the harness emits an UNRUN receipt with zero result rows rather than any number.
lanes.status: v0.1 — RAN 2026-08-28, verdict VOID-EQUIVALENT on the reasoning axis. Executed twice; run 1 scored 6/6 for all four tiers (spread 0, VOID by the pre-registered rule) and run 2 scored 5/6/6/6/5 where both non-PASS cells were non-reasoning (one TLS transport error, one omitted ANSWER line). Across both runs 46 of 46 answered cells were correct and not one attractor was taken. The lane is live and reproducible but has NOT separated the tiers: routing-table.json stays at rounds=0, confidence=low, autoApply=false, because a void-equivalent round is not evidence and does not count toward the A2 two-round floor. Note R4 (work-samples) DID separate on output discipline under load, an axis this card does not score — see the 2026-09-19 correction in R5-DESIGN.md.
